technology_name: Rapid Point-of-Care Diagnostics for Viral Infections: Lateral Flow & RT-LAMP Assays
problem_solved: Lack of timely, accessible, and cost-effective diagnostics for acute viral infections in outbreak-prone regions with limited centralized lab infrastructure.
description: A next-generation diagnostic platform integrating antigen-antibody detection via lateral flow assays and nucleic acid detection using isothermal reverse transcription loop-mediated amplification (RT-LAMP). The lateral flow devices provide visual viral protein detection within minutes. The cartridge-based RT-LAMP enables rapid viral genetic amplification at a constant temperature, eliminating the need for complex thermocyclers. Both formats deliver results in 15-30 minutes and require minimal training, making them optimized for field and frontline deployment.
applications:
• Frontline diagnostics in community clinics and mobile health units

• Field surveillance and rapid epidemic response by public health agencies

• Commercial manufacturing of rapid lateral flow strips and RT-LAMP diagnostic cartridges

• Stockpiling for pandemic preparedness in low-resource and high-risk regions
